Troubleshooting Beacon RUM

Most problems with Beacon RUM come from the snippet, the browser or the network. Work through the section that matches what you see.

6. Data stops after a page change

If data stops after you change a page template, make sure the Beacon RUM snippet is still in the head of every page and that it loads before other scripts that capture errors.

7. Content Security Policy (CSP) configuration for the Beacon RUM snippet

Problem:

If you see an error after adding the Beacon RUM snippet to your web page, your site's Content Security Policy (CSP) may be blocking it. A CSP limits which outside scripts and network requests a page may use, so when it blocks the snippet no data is collected.

Solution:

To let the snippet work, update your CSP so the page may load from the Beacon RUM servers. This is the configuration it needs:

<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://static.beaconrum.example.com; connect-src 'self' https://collect.beaconrum.example.com;">

Note

  • Change the domain names for the region your account is in.
  • For example, accounts on European servers use https://static.beaconrum.example.eu instead of https://static.beaconrum.example.com.

If this doesn't solve it, contact the support team.
